# Test 20261124-161745-0166: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| missing_action | 2 | turn 2, trace.jsonl:15, APP_SPEC.md:21, APP_SPEC.md:42 | After "Please reserve 1 teapot set for my order 6210.", the app called `shop.reserve` without the stock check required for that turn. The stock lookup in turn 1 answered the earlier availability question. |
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:17, trace.jsonl:18, services.py:44, stock.json:4, RULES.md:5 | The app sent the same `{"order": "6210", "sku": "teapot-set", "qty": 1}` request twice. Both POSTs succeeded and created separate reservations, `RS-584CF5` and `RS-357909`, holding two sets for a request for one. The retry loop sends the second POST even after HTTP 200. |
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:20, stock.json:4, RULES.md:6 | The reply said "I've reserved 1 teapot set for order 6210." The stock service held two for that order and the reply reported only the second reservation, `RS-357909`. |
| unsupported_reply | 3 | trace.jsonl:17, trace.jsonl:18, trace.jsonl:30, trace.jsonl:32 | The reply attributed the inventory drop to "your reservation and that of another customer." Both recorded reservations were for order `6210`. The reported stock count of 1 matched the stock service. |

## Notes

The transcript seal was intact. The audit found no breaks across the three turns, and the automated findings list was empty. The manifest lists no registered spec, so this evaluation used the project's `APP_SPEC.md` and `RULES.md`.

I checked the app and stock service code, the proxied stock responses, and the project state files. `stock.json` corroborates both reservations and the final count of 1. `state.json` contains the three case notes for this run. The test has no sealed `app-state/` snapshot.

All turns were within the project limits of 30 seconds and 2,000 model-session output tokens per turn. The respective measurements were 3.588, 3.470 and 3.720 seconds, and 134, 135 and 105 output tokens.

## Tester notes

The tester wrote no note.

## Coverage

A proxy saw each egress part.
answer:
[Evaluation report](<project>/.nookku/tests/20261124-161745-0166/report.md) records four issues.

The app skipped the required stock check, reserved two teapot sets for order 6210, and confirmed only one. It correctly reported that one set remained, then incorrectly attributed the extra reservation to another customer.

The test seal was intact. All three turns met the performance limits in the project’s `APP_SPEC.md`, which I used because the manifest registered no spec.
